description.zh: 借用早期个人网站与桌面浏览器的视觉语言：灰色凹凸边框、衬线文字、蓝色下划线链接、侧栏目录和访客计数器。它表达的是手工制作网页的亲切感；不等同于像素艺术，也不需要牺牲今天的键盘操作、响应式布局和阅读体验。
description.en: A visual language borrowed from early personal websites and desktop browsers: grey beveled borders, serif text, blue underlined links, directory sidebars and visitor counters. It recalls the intimacy of a handmade website without sacrificing modern keyboard access, responsive layout or readability.

use_when.zh: 个人主页、爱好者站点、互联网历史展览或怀旧创意项目。
use_when.en: Personal sites, fan pages, internet-history exhibits and nostalgic creative projects.

use_when.zh: 希望强调手工整理、慢慢发现和个人表达的内容。
use_when.en: Content that celebrates human curation, slow discovery and personal expression.

avoid_when.zh: 高密度工作系统或依赖可信支付与身份验证的关键流程。
avoid_when.en: Dense work applications and critical payment or identity flows.

avoid_when.zh: 不要复制闪烁文字、弹窗广告、固定宽度和过小触控目标等旧网页缺陷。
avoid_when.en: Do not bring back blinking text, pop-up ads, rigid widths or tiny touch targets.

note.zh: 目录侧栏、短文和精选链接组成的手工小站。
note.en: A handmade site with a directory sidebar, short writing and curated links.

note.zh: 用标题栏、菜单和凹凸边框营造桌面窗口层次。
note.en: Title bars, menus and beveled borders evoke a desktop window.

note.zh: 像素艺术由点阵与有限色板定义；复古互联网由页面结构、超链接和旧浏览器视觉语汇定义，可包含照片与常规文字。
note.en: Pixel art is defined by bitmap edges and limited palettes; Retro Web is defined by page structure, hyperlinks and browser-era conventions, and can include photos and ordinary type.

task.zh: 打开目录中的页面，再向留言簿写一句话。留言仅存在当前演示内，不发送到任何服务，刷新即清空。
task.en: Explore the directory, then add a guestbook message. Messages exist only in this preview, are never sent to a service, and disappear on reload.

checks.zh: 用 Tab 和 Enter 切换目录；当前页面有文字加粗和明确状态。
checks.en: Use Tab and Enter to navigate; the current page has bold text and an explicit state.

checks.zh: 试一次空白留言和正常留言，观察验证与提交反馈。
checks.en: Try an empty message and a valid one, then observe validation and feedback.

checks.zh: 缩到窄容器时目录换行，内容依然可读。
checks.en: At narrow widths the directory wraps and the content stays readable.

notes.zh: 用 inset/outset 或多层阴影表达灰色面板层次；正文使用可读字号，链接保留下划线。视觉样张可以还原固定构图，真实交互区必须换行并支持键盘。留言只用组件状态，明确不持久保存。
notes.en: Use inset/outset borders or layered shadows for grey panels. Keep readable type and underlined links. A visual study may preserve its composition, while the interactive area must wrap and support keyboards. Store demo messages in component state only and disclose that they are not persisted.

typography.zh: 衬线正文、系统字体菜单、可读的蓝色下划线链接。
typography.en: Serif body copy, system-font menus and readable blue underlined links.

color.zh: 浅灰窗口、白色内容、深蓝标题栏与链接。
color.en: Grey chrome, white content and dark-blue title bars and links.

border.zh: 方角与 2px 凹凸边框，无模糊投影。
border.en: Square corners and 2px beveled borders without blurred shadows.

shadow.zh: 使用边框明暗方向表达凹凸，不加模糊阴影。
shadow.en: Use light and dark border edges for relief, without blurred shadows.

spacing.zh: 紧凑但保持足够触控面积，窄屏目录换行。
spacing.en: Compact spacing with adequate targets and a wrapping directory.

motion.zh: 即时切换，避免闪烁和自动滚动。
motion.en: Immediate changes without blinking or automatic scrolling.

states.zh: 当前页加粗、焦点有清晰轮廓，表单反馈使用实时区域。
states.en: Bold current-page text, a clear focus ring and a live region for form feedback.

keywords.zh: 经典界面 · 超链接 · 手作网页

preview.heroSub: 一个值得慢慢发现的互联网角落。

basic.zh: 使用复古互联网风格设计个人主页。保留灰色凹凸窗口、衬线正文、蓝色下划线链接和目录侧栏；保留现代可访问性，不使用闪烁文字和侵入弹窗。
basic.en: Design a personal homepage in Retro Web style with grey beveled chrome, serif copy, blue underlined links and a directory sidebar. Retain modern accessibility; avoid blinking text and intrusive pop-ups.

design.zh: 以白色内容区和浅灰窗口形成层次，深蓝标题栏配系统字体。紧凑边距、方角和凹凸边框传达旧浏览器质感；链接必须可辨，触控目标不能随缩景变小。
design.en: Layer white content inside grey chrome with a dark-blue system-font title bar. Compact spacing, square corners and beveled borders evoke a vintage browser. Keep links recognizable and targets large enough.

implementation.zh: 复用语义 HTML，以 flex-wrap 让侧栏和内容响应窄屏。使用真正按钮或链接、可见 focus 和 aria-current。访客留言仅作为本地模拟，提交时明确反馈、不向外部服务发送内容。
implementation.en: Use semantic HTML and flex-wrap to adapt the sidebar and content. Use real buttons or links, visible focus and aria-current. Keep guestbook entries as a local simulation with explicit feedback and no external requests.

agent.zh:
检查项目现有路由和样式后，创建一个复古互联网个人主页。
包含目录导航、内容区和仅本地模拟的留言簿，所有页面入口都必须有效。
用灰色凹凸窗口、深蓝标题栏、衬线正文与蓝色下划线链接建立风格，不以整张截图替代 DOM。
不新增后端、凭据或外部请求。键盘可以完成切换和留言，空白提交有明确反馈，窄屏无页面横向溢出。
验证中英文本、焦点、页面切换与刷新后的状态边界，再报告实际通过和未验证的检查。
agent.en:
Inspect existing routing and styles, then create a Retro Web personal homepage.
Include working directory navigation, content and a local-only guestbook simulation.
Use grey beveled chrome, a navy title bar, serif copy and blue underlined links; never replace the DOM with a screenshot.
Add no backend, credentials or external requests. Support keyboard navigation and messages, clear empty-submit feedback and narrow layouts without page overflow.
Verify both languages, focus, navigation and state after reload. Report passed and unverified checks accurately.
